_comment: Ordered event sequences and the tables they fold to. Every case must fold to the same tables in every order of its events; the Go test tries every permutation of up to seven events and forty shuffles beyond that, and the Swift test under app/shared/Fold reads this file by path. hlc stamps are written short (wall:counter:device) and compared zero-padded; a field that is null, empty, zero or false is left out. Persons are pa and pb on devices a and b; L1 is the household's default list.

cases.name: two devices name melk offline: the earlier stamp owns the name, the other merges into it
re-add after clear opens a new era; the cleared one is the purchase record
duplicate ids are applied once
re-adding a checked entry unchecks it and takes the new note
a clear takes the entries checked before its boundary and leaves the rest
an out flag adds the item to the default list for that home; clearing it flags the item have; a later flag wins
clearing an entry for a home flags it have at the clear, with the clear's stamp
staples: the latest add and the latest remove decide
an explicit merge keeps the dropped name as an alias and moves flags and entries
list names are last-writer-wins and an archive sticks
a trip moves the flags and puts the moved items on the default list for the from-home
a rename into an existing name merges, and leaves no alias behind
an edit changes quantity and unit and keeps the check; a move sets the sort
spots and photos append; an unknown kind is skipped
a default list created after an out flag still gets the item
an uncheck restores a struck entry; homes rename last-writer-wins and archive; a spot archives
a planned trip is shared: the later plan wins on date and list, arriving keeps the plan and fills arrived_at
a cancel sticks whichever side of the plan it lands
not needed takes the open entry off the list without a purchase record; the next add opens a new era
a remove closes a struck era as well, the clear after it finds nothing, and a remove older than the add loses
a tasks list is created as one and stays one under a rename; its done tasks clear like purchases but are none
a proposal from a photo stays open until a flag is written after it, which closes it; one before it does not
a declined proposal closes at the decline, and a newer proposal for the same item closes the older one
a retired item stops coming up but keeps its history; named again, by a new id in full or by its own id, it is back, and a merge into it brings it back too
cards: the add fixes the owner, edits are last-writer-wins among themselves, the server's logos among themselves, an archive sticks and a later edit still lands
